question: Which initiation should be given after declaring the firm-vow initiation?
premises: The firm-vow initiation has been declared.
The sequence continues with another giving.
The next initiation is the offering of the five senses.
inference: After declaring the firm-vow initiation, the teacher should give the initiation of offering the five senses.
plain_english: Having declared the initiation of firm vow, the teacher should give the initiation of offering the five senses.
